description:
Burger Shop 2 is a time-management restaurant game serving breakfast, lunch,
and dinner across 120 Story Mode levels in 8 stages.

v0.2.0.description:
Added support for Burger Shop 2! The setup process is similar to Burger Shop 1 and the associated files include "Burger Shop 2" in the name.

### Burger Shop 1
See the [setup guide](https://github.com/zsiegel701/Archipelago/blob/burger-shop/worlds/burger_shop/docs/setup_en.md) for full installation and connection instructions.
See [this page](https://github.com/zsiegel701/Archipelago/blob/burger-shop/worlds/burger_shop/docs/en_Burger%20Shop.md) for details on what is randomized.

### Burger Shop 2
See the [setup guide](https://github.com/zsiegel701/Archipelago/blob/burger-shop/worlds/burger_shop_2/docs/setup_en.md) for full installation and connection instructions.
See [this page](https://github.com/zsiegel701/Archipelago/blob/burger-shop/worlds/burger_shop_2/docs/en_Burger%20Shop%202.md) for details on what is randomized.

### Additional Changes
- Removed the "user_" prefix when logging that a file was found.
- Only update the level count when an Archipelago save file is detected to prevent messing with existing save files.
v0.2.0.title: Burger Shop v0.2.0

v0.2.1.description: - Removed "Peas and Carrots" which will now be unlocked by receiving "Peas" and "Carrots" individually.  This avoids the issue of having too many items in the item pool when the maximum number of items are generated.
v0.2.1.title: Burger Shop v0.2.1

v0.2.2.description:
- Removed extra recipes from being added to the item pool when starter recipes are enabled
- Added extra handling for profile names containing non-standard characters

Only the .apworld files are changed in this release
v0.2.2.title: Burger Shop v0.2.2

v0.3.0.description:
## New Configuration Options
- Customer Slots: Forces levels to use a specified number of customer slots.
- Character Randomization: Randomizes the characters in each level.

### Burger Shop 1
See the [setup guide](https://github.com/zsiegel701/Archipelago/blob/burger-shop/worlds/burger_shop/docs/setup_en.md) for full installation and connection instructions.
See [this page](https://github.com/zsiegel701/Archipelago/blob/burger-shop/worlds/burger_shop/docs/en_Burger%20Shop.md) for details on what is randomized.

### Burger Shop 2
See the [setup guide](https://github.com/zsiegel701/Archipelago/blob/burger-shop/worlds/burger_shop_2/docs/setup_en.md) for full installation and connection instructions.
See [this page](https://github.com/zsiegel701/Archipelago/blob/burger-shop/worlds/burger_shop_2/docs/en_Burger%20Shop%202.md) for details on what is randomized.

### Additional Changes
- If the game is loaded before the client is connected and additional changes are needed to the game that cannot be done mid-session, the client will now mention that the game must be restarted.
- Ninja orders will not include bonus recipes to prevent orders that cannot be completed.
- Schoolgirl orders that are normally for 3 items will always be for 3 items.
- Orders that would be empty due to a lack of ingredient unlocks will now fallback to the Dude's order.
- The starter recipes option will now add a toasted breakfast item as well as a dinner meat item

All files have been updated in this version.  To reinstall the game files, delete the existing archipelago folder in your Burger Shop installation directory and add the same folder from the corresponding zip file of this release.
v0.3.0.title: Burger Shop v0.3.0

v0.3.1.description:
- The Ninja order will not cause a crash after unlocking certain breakfast sandwiches
- The Alien dinner order will unlock ranch correctly

Only the burger_shop_2.apworld has been updated in this release.
v0.3.1.title: Burger Shop v0.3.1

v0.3.2.description:
This release contains several QOL updates for both Burger Shop 1 and 2.

- The client will create and manage its own Archipelago save file.  This means a new save file is no longer needed for an Archipelago session, you just need to connect the client then load the Archipelago save file in Burger Shop.
- Locations sent to Burger Shop will now automatically show that level as a 5-star completion on the map screen.  The exceptions to this are level 80 for Burger Shop 1 and Levels 118, 119, and 120 for Burger Shop 2, since they are required to reach the goal.
- The zip file containing the game files have been updated to make re-installation easier.  You just need to copy over the "archipelago" and "properties" folder into your Burger Shop installation directory and replace all files.
- The Burger Shop client windows are now named to make it easier to identify them.

Additionally, 
- The Old Chap, Dog Lover, and Shirtless Guy customers cannot be placed in level 1 if character randomization is turned on, to prevent the rare case that there are no available levels in logic for the first 15 levels.
v0.3.2.title: Burger Shop v0.3.2
